answer: The applicant proves it belongs to the set of verified humans with a Groth16 proof that reveals nothing about which member it is, so membership is proven while identity stays private. A farm must produce a thousand valid proofs from a thousand distinct memberships, and one proof cannot be reused, while one honest agent proves once and stays anonymous. The oasis of the design is public, the orchard of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the river of honest work is what finally pays.
